records.text: Candace Owens said the Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood was built where Alexander II's carriage was bombed.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Petersburg, and I'm going to show you a video that I shot right in the spot where the bomb was thrown on him. ... verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood was built on the site where Alexander II was mortally wounded by a bomb in March 1881.
